## ✨ Highlights

- **👥 Use different signed-in users in one session** — `playwright-cli
tab-new https://example.com --isolated-context=user-b` opens a tab with
separate cookies and storage. Tabs with the same context name share
their login state; different names stay isolated.
([microsoft/playwright#43087](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43087))
- **🎬 Smaller video recordings with less encoding CPU** —
`playwright-cli video-start demo.webm` now records with VP9, keeping the
same WebM output format. Stop and save the recording with
`playwright-cli video-stop`.
([microsoft/playwright#43021](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43021))
- **📋 Keep console messages and requests across navigations**
([#479](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli/issues/479)) —
`playwright-cli console --all` and `playwright-cli requests --all`
include retained entries from earlier navigations, so warnings and
failed requests are not lost when checking a multi-page flow. Request
numbers stay stable for `playwright-cli request 5`.
([microsoft/playwright#43526](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43526))
- **🔎 Keep common searches from flooding the agent's context**
([microsoft/playwright#42077](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/42077))
— `playwright-cli find button --max-results=5` returns at most five
matching items and reports the total match count.
([microsoft/playwright#42947](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/42947))
- **🍪 Delete one site's cookie without signing out of others**
([microsoft/playwright#43310](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43310))
— `playwright-cli cookie-delete session_id --domain=example.com
--path=/` removes only the cookie matching that name, domain and path,
leaving same-named cookies elsewhere intact.
([microsoft/playwright#43319](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43319))
- **🔒 Redact session tokens in URLs printed in responses**
([microsoft/playwright-mcp#1791](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp/issues/1791))
— add `"redactUrlParams": ["access_token", "code"]` to
`.playwright/cli.config.json` to replace those query and fragment
parameter values with `<redacted>` in command responses.
([microsoft/playwright#43258](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43258))

## 🐛 Fixes

- `fix(cli): do not force-kill the browser on close` — `playwright-cli
close` lets Chrome shut down normally, preventing temporary app-clone
folders from accumulating on macOS.
([#475](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli/issues/475),
[microsoft/playwright#43229](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43229))
- `fix(cli): respect npm registry config in update check` — update
checks honor npm's registry, scoped registry, proxy and authentication
settings instead of contacting the public registry directly when a
custom registry is configured.
([#478](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli/issues/478),
[#484](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli/pull/484))
- `fix(cli): report run-code route handler exception once and verbatim`
— asynchronous route callback errors return their original message
without duplicated errors or an extra `Error:` prefix.
([#476](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli/issues/476),
[microsoft/playwright#43203](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43203))
- `fix(chromium): do not hang on pages without a renderer when
connecting over CDP` — `attach --cdp` handles discarded or crashed tabs
without wedging every command; a follow-up closes those tabs while
preserving live ones.
([microsoft/playwright#41714](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/41714),
[microsoft/playwright#42936](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/42936),
[microsoft/playwright#43075](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43075))
- `fix(chromium): report local frames of existing oopifs when connecting
over CDP` — attaching to an already-loaded page discovers nested frames
correctly instead of replacing the main document with a sandboxed
iframe.
([microsoft/playwright#42955](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/42955),
[microsoft/playwright#43000](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43000))
- `fix(mcp): report invalid element targets and accept locators in any
language` — action targets accept JavaScript, Python, Java and C#
locators. Invalid targets explain the accepted forms, including how to
pass a bare snapshot ref.
([microsoft/playwright-mcp#1797](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp/issues/1797),
[microsoft/playwright#43539](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43539))
- `fix(mcp): normalize bare host URLs and loopback IP addresses` —
`playwright-cli open 127.0.0.1:3000` uses HTTP, and bare external hosts
with ports are normalized to HTTPS rather than mistaken for custom
schemes.
([microsoft/playwright#43263](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43263),
[microsoft/playwright#43264](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43264))
- `fix(mcp): race browser_navigate_back and forward against modal
states` — `go-back` and `go-forward` surface navigation dialogs
immediately so they can be handled, rather than hanging until timeout.
([microsoft/playwright#43251](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43251),
[microsoft/playwright#43252](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43252))
- `fix(mcp): preserve origin filters when modifying request headers` —
header-only `route` handlers no longer skip configured
allowed/blocked-origin filters.
([microsoft/playwright#43630](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43630),
[microsoft/playwright#43637](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43637))
- `fix(mcp): pass custom headers to route.fulfill when mocking response`
— mocked `route` responses retain supplied headers, including CORS and
cache headers.
([microsoft/playwright#43245](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43245),
[microsoft/playwright#43244](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43244))
- `fix(mcp): match browser_route header names case-insensitively` —
request-header replacement and removal work consistently regardless of
header-name casing.
([microsoft/playwright#43215](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43215),
[microsoft/playwright#43227](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43227))
- `fix(mcp): match cookie list domain filter on domain boundaries` —
`cookie-list --domain=example.com` includes that domain and its
subdomains, not unrelated names such as `my-example.com`; matching
ignores case and a leading dot.
([microsoft/playwright#43308](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43308),
[microsoft/playwright#43316](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43316))
- `fix(mcp): do not match sibling paths in cookie-list path filter` —
`cookie-list --path=/api` includes `/api` and paths under `/api/`, not
`/apikeys`.
([microsoft/playwright#43366](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43366),
[microsoft/playwright#43368](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43368))
- `fix(mcp): ask for a cookie domain when the page has no host` —
`cookie-set` on `about:blank` or a data URL asks for `--domain` instead
of returning an internal assertion error.
([microsoft/playwright#43309](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43309),
[microsoft/playwright#43318](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43318))
- `fix(mcp): pass credentials from --proxy-server as proxy
username/password` — authenticated proxy URLs supplied through
`PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_PROXY_SERVER` retain their credentials instead of
failing proxy authentication.
([microsoft/playwright#43048](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43048),
[microsoft/playwright#43071](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43071))
- `fix(mcp): accept Windows paths in browser_resume location` —
`pause-at` accepts Windows source locations such as
`C:\tests\example.spec.ts:42`.
([microsoft/playwright#43340](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43340),
[microsoft/playwright#43349](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43349))
- `fix(video): hide ffmpeg console windows on Windows` — `video-start`
no longer opens a terminal window that steals focus during background
recording.
([microsoft/playwright#43515](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43515),
[microsoft/playwright#43575](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43575))
- `feat(cli): keep sockets in XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` — Unix CLI sessions and
the dashboard prefer `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/playwright` over the shared
temporary directory when it is usable.
([microsoft/playwright#43698](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43698),
[microsoft/playwright#43732](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43732))
- `fix(tracing): do not store secrets in trace context options` — trace
metadata no longer copies credential-bearing context options such as
HTTP credentials, proxy credentials, extra headers and storage-state
cookies.
([microsoft/playwright#38673](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/38673),
[microsoft/playwright#43220](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43220))
- `fix(aria): preserve iframe snapshots with fallback text` — snapshots
show a loaded iframe's content and element refs even when its HTML
contains fallback text.
([microsoft/playwright#43628](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43628),
[microsoft/playwright#43635](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43635))
- `fix(aria): quote ~, .inf and .nan in aria snapshots` — YAML-special
text remains a string when snapshot output is parsed or reused.
([microsoft/playwright#43451](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43451),
[microsoft/playwright#43469](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43469))
- `fix(a11y): treat inert elements and content outside of modal dialogs
as hidden` — snapshots exclude controls that cannot currently be used,
and click/fill actions wait for targets to stop being inert rather than
silently misfiring.
([microsoft/playwright#36938](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/36938),
[microsoft/playwright#42967](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/42967),
[microsoft/playwright#43211](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43211))
- `fix(webmcp): handle Chromium tool API changes` — WebMCP tool
discovery tolerates Chromium's null input schemas while preserving the
existing tool shape.
([microsoft/playwright#43578](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/43578))

## 📦 Upgrading

```bash
npm install -g @playwright/cli@0.1.23
```

This release uses Playwright `1.65.0-alpha-2026-10-30`.
